language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: You can change this anytime.
title.tagline: Pick your favorite. Make it yours.
rotate.title: Best in portrait
rotate.body: Turn your phone upright to play.
install.title: Install Lucky Claw
install.body: Add the game to your Home Screen for fullscreen play and faster launch.
install.ios: Tap Share, then choose Add to Home Screen.
install.manual: Open your browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
menu.title: Main Menu
menu.subtitle: What would you like to do?
menu.featureComing: This section is coming in a later build.
settings.title: Settings
settings.dataNote: Progress and high scores are stored on this device.
settings.clearDataSub: Reset scores, progress, trophies, collection and unlocked themes
settings.clearConfirm1: This will permanently erase Lucky Claw progress stored on this device, including scores, stage progress, trophies, collection, Claw Points and unlocked themes.
settings.clearKeeps: Language, music, sound, haptics and accessibility preferences will be kept.
settings.clearConfirm2: This cannot be undone. Clear Lucky Claw progress on this device now?
settings.diagnosticsSub: Copy build and device-safe troubleshooting details
settings.legalCenterSub: Terms, privacy, copyright and third-party notices
support.note: Support is completely optional and never changes gameplay, claw odds, rewards or progression.
support.promptPayLead: Scan the QR with a Thai banking app. If you are using the same phone, open the full-size QR and save it from the browser if needed.
support.verify: Please verify the recipient name in your banking app before confirming the payment.
trust.localBody: Your game data stays on this device.
trust.supportBody: Supporting Lucky Claw never changes gameplay.
trust.noGamblingBody: No real-money prizes or cash-value game items.
trust.clearBody: Clearing game data permanently resets local progress.
howto.goalBody: Score enough points before time runs out to clear each stage. Different plushies are worth different amounts.
howto.joystick: Move the joystick left or right to line up the claw.
howto.shuffle: Hold SHUFFLE to rearrange the pile while your shuffle time remains.
howto.drop: Press DROP when you are ready. The claw descends, closes, lifts and carries automatically.
howto.scoreBody: A well-centered grab is more secure. Off-center grabs can slip on the way up, just like a real claw machine.
settings.reportProblemSub: Tell Benedict Interactive what went wrong
settings.sendFeedbackSub: Share an idea or tell us about your experience
feedback.reportIntro: Tell us what happened. Lucky Claw will prepare an email to Benedict Interactive Support.
feedback.feedbackIntro: Share what worked well, what could be better, or an idea you would like us to consider.
feedback.reportPlaceholder: What happened? What were you trying to do?
feedback.techNote: Only build, language, display mode, viewport and browser user-agent details are included.
feedback.privacy: Please do not include passwords, payment details or other sensitive personal information.
feedback.mailNote: Your email app will open. Nothing is sent until you choose Send there.
feedback.messageRequired: Please write a short message first.
settings.exitGameSub: Save your progress and leave Lucky Claw
exit.title: Exit Game?
exit.body: Your progress will be saved before you leave.
exit.savedBody: Your progress has been saved. If Lucky Claw does not close automatically, you can safely close this window or app.
